what_happened.line: The Public Access Cable Committee heard that hiring a videographer has failed twice, and chose to watch how hiring goes rather than write to HR.
A motion to approve buying a GoPro camera was made and seconded; the minutes could not record the outcome of the vote because it was not audible.
The manager said a new control room laptop is needed because the presentation computer failed, and the committee discussed trimming specs to stay under a price threshold.
The station will publish accepted presentation formats and ports and email board and committee chairs once the Town Hall computer is chosen.
The August minutes were accepted by majority, and the next meeting was set for 6 o'clock on November 6.

why_it_matters: Local meetings reach residents through this station's recordings, and an unfilled videographer post and a failed presentation computer limit how much of Town Hall can be filmed and shown.
An audio consultant for Town Hall is planned under an approved ARPA proposal, so what residents can hear in recorded meetings may change.
watch_next: Next committee meeting at 6 o'clock on November 6.
The enterprise fund quarterly investment report, which is delayed and will be emailed to the committee when received.
